item.title: DOF’s Financial Services announces relocation and temporary closure
item.description: (Department of Finance) — As a reminder, Financial Services is relocating to its Capitol Hill office. Operations will be temporarily closed on Feb. 5, 6, and 9, 2026. item.title: CNMI, Interior officials advance fiscal reform talks ahead of Section 902 consultations
item.description: (Office of the CNMI Governor) — Senior officials from the U.S. Department of the Interior and the Office of Insular Affairs are in the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands this week to engage in a series of high-level meetings focused on fiscal reform progress, audit milestones, and budgetary planning. The post CNMI, Interior officials advance fiscal reform talks ahead of Section 902 consultations appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Honoring the life and legacy of Lino Mettao ‘Tata Lino’ Olopai
item.description: THE Commonwealth is reflecting on the life of Lino Mettao “Tata Lino” Olopai, a revered Carolinian cultural leader, master navigator, and guardian of ancestral knowledge who passed away peacefully on Jan. 29 at the age of 86. His loss is deeply felt across the Marianas, where he was widely regarded as one of the region’s most influential cultural figures. The post Honoring the life and legacy of Lino Mettao ‘Tata Lino’ Olopai appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.description: PHILIPPINE Airlines is targeting regional markets and sees long-term potential in the CNMI as it prepares to resume direct Manila–Saipan service on March 29, restoring a vital travel link for families, workers, and international visitors. item.title: $2.3 million grant for NMC
item.description: Helmsley Charitable Trust Trustee Walter Panzirer, Rural Healthcare Program Director Wayne Booze and Program Officer Elizabeth Ruen listen as Northern Marianas College Nursing Department Chair Rosa Aldan explains lab equipment during a recent site visit. Also pictured is NMC Senior Vice President Frankie Eliptico. The trust awarded NMC a $2.3 million grant to transform its nursing and allied health programs and address the CNMI’s urgent healthcare workforce needs. NMC photo The post $2.3 million
